Access.description:
An item's access level: its JSDoc's `@public`, `@protected`, `@package`, `@private` or
`@access` tag, or else `protected` for a TypeScript `protected` member and `public` for the rest.

globals.description: Globals: `window.a = …` and `globalThis.a = …` at the top level.

anyOf.description: Files, each winning over the ones before it.

Extends.description: A config file to extend, or a list of them.

names.description: Regexes: an item whose name matches one doesn't count. A member matches by its own name or as `Class.member`.

Inherit.description: What documents an item by inheriting its docs.

oneOf.description: An `@inheritdoc` tag, or TypeScript's `override` on a class member.

Kind.description: What kind of declaration an item is.

oneOf.description: `function f() {}`, or a function assigned to an export.
`class C {}`, or a class assigned to an export.
A class method or an interface method signature.
A getter (with its setter, if any), a lone setter, or an `accessor` property.
A class field or an interface property signature.
`const`, `let` or `var`, or another value CommonJS exports by name.

Override.description: Settings for the files some globs match, in place of the top-level ones.

exclude.description: In place of the top-level `exclude`, for these files.

files.description: Gitignore-style globs of the files it's for, relative to this file's folder.

anyOf.description: A documented percentage from 0 to 100, or a negative whole number for at most that many undocumented items.

additionalProperties.description: For the files a gitignore-style glob matches, relative to this file's folder, together.

perFile.description: For each file on its own.

threshold.description: In place of the top-level `threshold`, for these files.

oneOf.description: What a module exports, with the public members of exported classes and interfaces.
Every module-level declaration, exported or not.

description: docov's settings. Flags on the command line win over them.

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editors.

access.description: Count only items with these access levels, by their access tags. Without it, access tags change nothing.

baseline.description: A file of undocumented items the gates let pass, relative to this file's folder, as `docov --write-baseline` writes it.

exclude.description: Gitignore-style globs of files to leave out, relative to this file's folder, on top of .gitignore.

excludeTags.description: Leave out items whose JSDoc has one of these tags, named without the @ (`internal` for @internal).

exports.description: Which ways of exporting count under the `exports` scope. Globals are items under either scope only when on.

extends.description: Config files this one builds on, relative to its folder. Its keys win over theirs, and a later one's over an earlier one's.

ignoreDeprecated.description: Leave out items whose JSDoc has @deprecated.

inherit.description: What documents an item by inheriting its docs.

jsdocConfig.description: A jsdoc.json, relative to this file's folder, whose `source` picks the files: its `include` is the paths unless `paths` is set, and its `exclude`, `includePattern` and `excludePattern` leave files out.

kinds.description: Count only these kinds of item. Every kind counts without it.

maxUndocumented.description: The most undocumented items that pass.

nested.description: Scan each file with the nearest docov.json, docov.jsonc or .docovrc above it, up to this file's folder, merged over this one. Only the root config's counts.

overrides.description: Settings for the files globs match, in place of the top-level ones. For each file and setting, the last override that matches it and has the setting wins.

paths.description: Files and folders to scan, relative to this file's folder. Defaults to the folder docov runs in.

reportUnusedIgnores.description: Fail on a docov-ignore-next-line whose items are documented anyway.

requireDescription.description: Count a JSDoc block only with text before its first tag, or @description, @summary, @classdesc or @inheritdoc.

skipGenerated.description: Leave out files whose first comment has @generated.

anyOf.description: A documented percentage from 0 to 100, or a negative whole number for at most that many undocumented items.

additionalProperties.description: For the files a gitignore-style glob matches, relative to this file's folder, together.

perFile.description: For each file on its own.

threshold.description: The lowest documented percentage that passes, or thresholds by path: `global` for every file together, `perFile` for each file, and gitignore-style globs for the files each matches together.
